name: TC-15-sla-tracking
description: TC-15.1 & TC-15.2: SLA Tracking — View SLA fields on MR and WO entities

doc_metadata.title: TC-15.1 — MR SLA Tracking
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Maintenance Request. SLA tracking fields are auto-populated when an MR is submitted based on its priority level.

doc_metadata.title: TC-15.1 — MR SLA Fields
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance request list shows SLA status indicators. High-priority MRs have shorter response and resolution SLA targets. Fields include: SLA Response Due, SLA Resolution Due, SLA Status, Is Overdue.

doc_metadata.title: TC-15.2 — WO SLA Tracking
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Work Order. Work orders have stage-based SLA targets: Requested (8h), Approved (24h), In Progress (72h). SLA status updates automatically.

doc_metadata.title: TC-15.2 — WO SLA Status
doc_metadata.caption: The work order list shows SLA tracking per stage. As work orders progress through their lifecycle, SLA timers reset for each stage with appropriate targets.
